lines.trans: Fedya, my dear friend!
Chef, why are you so kind?
I urgently need your help.
No, chef, I am completely broke!
Not even a couple of thousand can be found?
You still owe me five thousand!
I will return everything tomorrow morning!
You always promise that, chef.
But today Spartak will definitely win!
Spartak is playing against a strong opponent.
They have roster problems!
Chef, football is pure lottery.
Do you not believe in our football?
I believe only in cash money!
